about.headline: Designing for Screen & High-Precision Print Production
about.bio: I'm Tusar Ahammad, a Graphic Designer trained at Creative IT Institute with over 6 years of expertise in brand design, store management, and industrial print machine operation across Bangladesh and Saudi Arabia.
about.card1Desc: Crafting logos, social media assets, carousel posts, and YouTube thumbnails with high precision.
about.card2Desc: Operating UV printers, plotters, and banner machines using Roland VersaWorks and SignMaster.
about.card3Desc: Over 3 years of supervisory experience managing store operations and production teams.
